Job Summary

PT Multi Farmindo Jaya is seeking a dedicated and proactive Safety, Health, and Environment (SHE) Coordinator for our Kabuh & Lengkong operations. The SHE Coordinator will be responsible for implementing, monitoring, and maintaining occupational health, safety, and environmental management systems across the designated sites. This role ensures full compliance with national regulations and company standards, fostering a zero-accident culture and minimizing environmental impact.

Job Responsibilities

* Monitor and ensure the implementation of all Safety, Health, and Environment (SHE) policies, procedures, and standards at the Kabuh & Lengkong facilities.
* Conduct regular workplace safety inspections, hazard identifications, and risk assessments (HIRADC) to prevent occupational accidents and illnesses.
* Lead the investigation of any workplace incidents, accidents, or near-misses, and prepare comprehensive reports with recommended corrective and preventive actions.
* Develop, coordinate, and deliver SHE training programs and safety induction sessions for employees, contractors, and visitors.
* Manage waste disposal processes, monitor wastewater treatment operations, and ensure overall environmental compliance in accordance with Indonesian regulations.
* Maintain accurate SHE documentation, including safety statistics, permits, and regulatory reports, for submission to management and government authorities.
* Coordinate emergency response drills and ensure all firefighting and first-aid equipment are regularly inspected and maintained in optimal condition.

Job Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health and Safety (K3), Environmental Engineering, Public Health, or a related discipline.
* Minimum of 2-3 years of experience as a SHE/HSE Coordinator, Officer, or Specialist, preferably within the agricultural, livestock, food production, or manufacturing industry.
* Must hold a valid General K3 Specialist certification (Ahli K3 Umum) from the Indonesian Ministry of Manpower (Kemnaker).
* Deep understanding of Indonesian SHE laws, regulations, and standards (such as SMK3, ISO 45001, and ISO 14001).
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to influence safety behaviors at all levels.
* Willingness to be stationed in and travel between the Kabuh & Lengkong operational areas.
